description: This file defines the FileContextTracker class responsible for tracking file operations, modifications, and context management within a project, particularly for handling stale file contexts and coordinating updates with a webview and task metadata.

classes.name: FileContextTracker
classes.description: A class for tracking file operations, managing file watchers, and updating task metadata to prevent stale contexts in a development environment.

methods.name: getCwd
methods.description: Retrieves the current working directory based on workspace folders.

methods.name: setupFileWatcher
methods.description: Sets up a file system watcher for a specific file if not already existing.

methods.name: trackFileContext
methods.description: Main method to track a file operation and set up watchers, called when a file is passed to the system.

methods.name: getContextProxy
methods.description: Retrieves the context proxy from the provider reference.

methods.name: saveTaskMetadata
methods.description: Saves task metadata to storage and posts message to webview.

methods.name: addFileToFileContextTracker
methods.description: Updates metadata with file status, timestamps, and source, marking files as active, stale, or edited.

methods.name: getAndClearRecentlyModifiedFiles
methods.description: Returns and clears the set of recently modified files.

methods.name: getAndClearCheckpointPossibleFile
methods.description: Returns and clears the set of files that can have checkpoints.

methods.name: markFileAsEditedByRoo
methods.description: Marks a file as recently edited by Roo to prevent false positives.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Disposes all file watchers and clears internal state.
